name: Transformer inrush-restraint interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Identifies the measured or calculated inrush information used by the selected differential scheme.
description: Identifies the measured or calculated inrush information used by the selected differential scheme. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Inrush discrimination quantities” at the input and “Inrush restraint state” at the output. The method must match the selected relay application.

Identify the sensor or calculation, its monitored zone and its assigned response. Alarm and trip thresholds, sensor fitting and protection settings belong to the selected transformer documentation and the approved protection design. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
